MRMAUS.darkHint: Matte backgrounds in Mausritter sheets, roll dialogs and chat cards.
MRMAUS.contrastHint: Stronger borders, text and keyboard focus.
MRMAUS.readableHint: Clear sans-serif lettering in sheets and cards.
MRMAUS.motionHint: Removes transitions and animations from Mausritter panels.
MRMAUS.helpHint: Show item details on hover or keyboard focus.
MRMAUS.operationFailed: Could not complete the action. See the Foundry console.
MRMAUS.noRoom: There is no free space for this item.
MRMAUS.strengthHint: Force and endurance. Roll a Strength save when the rules call for it.
MRMAUS.dexterityHint: Agility and reflexes. Roll a Dexterity save when the rules call for it.
MRMAUS.willHint: Courage and resolve. Roll a Will save when the rules call for it.
MRMAUS.healthHint: Hit protection. After armor, damage reduces HP before it reaches Strength.

Combat.Title: Mausritter Damage Helper
Combat.Settings_AutoCritical_Hint: When a pending STR save fails, adds Injured and posts the consequences.
Combat.Settings_ApplyArmor_Hint: Core rule: armor reduces incoming damage before HP/STR.
Combat.Settings_PromptStrengthSave_Hint: When damage reaches STR, creates a warning to resolve critical damage.
Combat.Settings_UseGrit_Hint: Optional rule for tables using GRIT as a buffer before HP. Off by default to preserve core Mausritter.
Combat.Settings_AutoUsage_Hint: Variant: mark one usage dot when using a weapon, spell or item. Disable to track usage using the core rules.
Combat.NoTargets: Target at least one token before applying damage.
Combat.NoPermission: You do not have permission to modify {name}.
Combat.NoActor: The targeted token has no actor.
Combat.Critical: {name} took STR damage. Make a STR save or suffer critical damage.
Combat.CriticalPending: {name}: pending STR save for critical damage.
Combat.CriticalSuccess: {name} succeeds on the STR save and can keep fighting.
Combat.CriticalFailure: {name} fails the STR save: they take the Injured condition and are incapacitated until tended to by an ally and able to take a short rest. If left untended for 6 exploration turns, they die.
Combat.ItemLossReminder: The Injured condition occupies space as a condition card; if there is no inventory space, decide which item must be dropped or lost to make room.
Combat.InjuredDesc: Disadvantage on STR and DEX saves.
Combat.UsageError: Could not spend a use of {name}. Check the console for details.
Combat.EnabledHint: Enables damage, critical saves and automatic item use in this world.
Combat.DamageError: Could not complete the damage application. Check the console and retry.
Combat.CriticalError: Could not resolve the critical save.
Combat.NoEditable: None of the targeted tokens can receive damage from this user.
Combat.LegacyActive: The standalone Damage Helper is handling combat. Deactivate it to use the integrated version.
Combat.CriticalManual: {name} fails the STR save. Apply the critical damage effects manually.
